title: Kerala Style Roasted Okra (Vendakka Mezhukkupuratti)
style: Crispy, spice-roasted okra with classic Kerala flavours and zero slime.
description: A simple Kerala-style okra stir-fry that’s crispy, aromatic, and perfectly spiced—no slime, just flavour.
steps: Rinse okra and pat completely dry with a kitchen towel to prevent sliminess.
Heat oil in a sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add mustard seeds and allow them to pop.
Add curry leaves and sliced okra. Let roast undisturbed for a couple of minutes.
Gently stir occasionally so all sides cook evenly.
Once okra starts browning at the edges and slime has mostly disappeared, add turmeric, cayenne, cumin, and salt. Mix well.
Reduce heat to medium and cook a few more minutes until spices are fragrant and okra is cooked through.
Serve hot as a side dish.
tips: High heat is key to keeping the okra crisp and non-slimy.
Add diced red onion before the okra for extra sweetness.
Finish with grated coconut for a traditional Kerala variation.
